source: The encampment of the Fertility Order in Port Santa sprawled along the city’s edge, nestled near the suburbs.
target: Castra Ordinis Fertilitatis in Portu Santa per limitem urbis se extendebant, prope suburbia condita.

source: It claimed an entire street, complete with fields, orchards, and a variety of livestock, providing a self-sufficient haven for the nuns when they weren’t on missions.
target: Totam viam occupabat, cum agris, hortis, et varietate pecorum instructa, qua monialibus otium proprium dabatur, cum missionibus non adfuerunt.

source: Lugano gripped Ludwig’s hand and raised his eyes to the green vines entwining the cloister’s spire, with the Sacred Emblem of Life at its center.
target: Lugano manum Ludovici prehendit et oculos levavit ad virides uvas circum turrim claustri infixas, in qua Sacrum Emblema Vitae in medium collocatum erat.

source: A simple depiction of a baby amidst wheat ears, flowers, spring water, and other symbols.
target: Depictio simplex infanti inter spigas tritici, flores, aquam fontis, et alia symbola.

source: Turning to Noelia, he uttered, “I was attacked. Just wrapped up my statement at the police station.”
target: Ad Noeliam conversus dixit: “Me oppugnatum sum. Mox testimonium meum in statione vigilum finivi.”

source: Noelia, adorned with a black hat adorned with white patterns, blending religion and combat, furrowed her brow and inquired, “Where’s Louis Berry?”
target: Noelia, pileo nigro cum figuris albis ornata, quae religionem et pugnam miscet, frontem contraxit et interrogavit: “Ubi est Louis Berry?”

source: Rather than delving into the specifics of Lugano’s assault, she honed in on the whereabouts of Louis Berry, the great adventurer.
target: Non ad intrandum in singularia oppugnationis Lugani se dedit, sed potius quaerebat ubi esset Louis Berry, magnus viator.

source: Lugano shook his head and replied earnestly, “I don’t know. He told me to come here after giving my statement and inform you that I was attacked.”
target: Lugano caput concussit et vere respondit: “Nescio. Mihi dixit ut post testimonium meum hic accederem et te certiorem facerem me oppugnatum esse.”

source: Noelia’s expression shifted to solemnity.
target: Vultus Noeliae ad sollemnitatem mutatus est.

source: In the bustling port district, standing before the robust grayish-black edifice of the Fisheries Guild,
target: In vivace regione portuaria, stans coram robusto aedificio cinereo–nigro Societatis Piscatoriae,

source: Lumian, now garbed in a white shirt, black vest, and brown pants, topped with a golden straw hat, casually strode to the building.
target: Lumian, nunc in camisā albā, loricā nigra et braccīs fuscīs indutus, atque pileō stramineō aureō completus, ad aedificium leviter processit.

source: The two guards stationed here lacked guns, carrying only straight swords on their backs and daggers at their waists, blending in with the multitude of passersby.
target: Duo custodes hic positi tormenta non gerebant, sed solum gladios rectos in tergo et pugiones ad latus portantes, inter multitudinem transeuntorum se conciliantes.

source: “Who are you looking for?” Both guards extended their hands simultaneously, halting Lumian’s advance.
target: «Quem quaeris?»

source: Lumian couldn’t “comprehend” Highlander. Without hesitation, he drew his revolver, pointed it towards the sky, and squeezed the trigger.
target: Lumian non potuit “Highlander” intellegere.

source: Amidst the gunshot’s echo, he slipped between the two guards, entering the castle-like abode of the Fisheries Guild.
target: Inter sonitum sclopetorum, inter duos custodes se fugiens, in aedificium quasi castelli Societatis Piscatoriae ingrediit.

source: The guards exchanged uncertain glances but refrained from intervening.
target: Custodes oculos incertos inter se commutaverunt, sed intervenire non ausi sunt.

source: One of them dashed towards the port’s police station, while the other hurried into the grayish-black building, aiming to report to his superior and seek guidance.
target: Unus eorum ad stationem vigilum portus festinavit, dum alter in aedificium cinereo–nigrum properavit ut superiori referret atque consilium quaereret.

source: Clutching his revolver, Lumian advanced at a measured pace. Beneath the puzzled stares of the staff, who hastily sidestepped, he traversed the hall and ascended the stairs leading to the committee member’s office.
target: Revolver suum tenens, Lumian gradibus modicis procedebat.

source: Just as he approached the second floor, a figure appeared before him.
target: Mox, cum ad secundum tabulatum appropinquaret, figura coram eo apparuit.

source: Bronze-hued skin, broad and sturdy physique, black hair, and blue eyes characterized the young man who had aided the Fisheries Guild’s president, Juan Oro.
target: Cutis aerea, corpus lato et robustum, capilli nigri et oculi caerulei iuvenem extollebant, qui praesidi Societatis Piscatoriae, Juan Oro, auxilium tulit.

source: He was Fernandez Oro, the old man’s grandson.
target: Ille erat Fernandez Oro, nepos senis.

source: Fernandez glared at Lumian ascending step by step, gritting his teeth.
target: Fernandez ad Lumian, qui gradatim ascendebat, intueri coepit, dentes strenue contrivens.

source: “How dare you intrude into the guild!”
target: «Quo audes in societatem irrumpere!»

source: Lumian paid him no heed. He maintained a steady pace, neither hastening nor slowing as he approached the entrance to the second floor.
target: Lumian eum non attendit.

source: Fernandez masked his expression, his back slightly arched, and his eyes appeared to radiate an ominous glow.
target: Fernandez vultum suum celavit, dorso paulum incurvato, et oculi eius lumen ominosum radiabant.

source: Suddenly, Lumian sensed a significant dimming of the ambient light.
target: Subito, Lumian lucis ambientis notabilem diminutionem sensit.

source: Simultaneously, an intangible force descended from above, entwining around his feet, making him feel shorter and causing his body to sway.
target: Simul, vis intangibilis ex alto descendit, pedes eius involvens, eum brevioris sensu efficit et corpus vacillare incitavit.

source: Fernandez, in contrast, seemed to grow taller, casting dense shadows that engulfed the corridor’s meager light.
target: Fernandez, contra, altior videri solebat, umbras densas proiciens quae lumen exiguum corridoris occulgebant.

source: Thud!
target: Tum!

source: Advancing, Fernandez swung his right fist towards Lumian’s head.
target: Procedens, Fernandez pugnus dextrum suum ad caput Lumiani ferivit.

source: A gusty wind permeated the space, propelling the fist with hammer-like force, guided by an unseen magnet.
target: Ventus impetuosus spatium pervasit, pugnum quasi malle impellens, ignoto magnete ductum.

source: Lumian gazed upward as something within him erupted, shattering the binding force.
target: Lumian sursum aspexit, cum aliquid intus in eo erupisset, vim ligantem frangens.

source: His thighs swelled suddenly, and his loose brown pants constricted.
target: Femoribus eius subito inflatis et braccae fuscae, quae olim erant laxae, contraxerunt.

source: He grew taller seemingly out of thin air, sleeves and pants tightening around bulging muscles.
target: Altior factus est, quasi ex aere, manicae et braccae circa musculosos conspicuos arcte cohibebantur.

source: Bang!
target: Bum!

source: A left punch from Lumian met Fernandez’s incoming fist in a thunderous collision, causing the stairs to quiver and sway.
target: Pugno sinistro a Lumiano, cum pugnus imminens Fernandez in collisione tonitruali occurrit, scalae trepidare et vacillare coegerunt.

source: Fernandez, forced back two steps, bore no fear but a hint of joy on his face.
target: Fernandez, duos gradus retrorsum coactus, timorem non sed parvam laetitiam in vultu gerebat.

source: Retreating, his eyes darkened with a touch of brilliance.
target: Retrocedens, oculi eius parvo fulgore obscurabantur.

source: Raising his left hand, a dark-green light swiftly concentrated on his unusually rough fingertips.
target: Levans manum sinistram, lumen viride obscurum celeriter in digitos eius insolito asperos concentratum est.

source: The light transformed into a ray, silently hurtling towards Lumian, momentarily immobilized by the collision.
target: Lumen in radium conversum est, silentio versus Lumian volans, momento collisione immobilis factus.

source: Fernandez chose close combat from the start, creating an opening for the ray, capable of disrupting the human structure and inducing swift internal injuries.
target: Fernandez ab initio modum pugnandi proximum elegit, angum pro radio efficiens, qui structuram humanam disrumpere et vulnera interna celeriter inferre posset.

source: The dark-green danger ray matched the speed of light. Lumian, unable to dodge in advance, could only watch as it struck between his chest and abdomen.
target: Radius periculi viridis obscuri luci celeritate aequabat.

source: Yet, the dark-green ray pierced through, striking only an illusion.
target: Attamen radius viridis obscuri pertransiit, tantum illusionem feriens.

source: Leveraging the Ascetic’s accumulated strength in clashing with Fernandez, Lumian had seized the chance to arch his back and stand in place like an arc, deftly evading potential sneak attacks.
target: Vi asceticorum in pugna cum Fernandez collecta utens, Lumian occasionem cepit dorsum suum arcum fingere atque in loco quasi arcus stantem, callide insidias evitans.

source: In this intricate dance, he even employed the Niese Face, creating an illusion of himself still standing upright!
target: In hoc saltatione intricata etiam Niese Faciem usus est, creans illusionem seipsum adhuc erectum stantem!

source: Gradually, the dark-green ray dissipated, vanishing around the corner of the stairs.
target: Paulatim, radius viridis obscuri dissipatus est, circa angulum scalarium evanescens.

source: Suddenly, a crimson fire, nearly white-hot, erupted from Lumian’s body.
target: Subito, ignis ruber, paene candide calens, ex corpore Lumiani erupit.

source: Transformed into a fireball, he hurtled towards Fernandez, who had just regained his footing.
target: Transmutatus in globum ignis, ad Fernandez festinans pervenit, qui modo pedes reciperaverat.

source: Fernandez’s pupils constricted, seemingly challenged by the blaze.
target: Pupillae Fernandez contractae sunt, quasi igne provocatae.

source: Swiftly, he sidestepped, clenched his right hand into a fist, and yanked it down.
target: Celeriter, se declinavit; dextram manum in pugnus comprimens eam deiecit.

source: An invisible force tugged Lumian to the ground, but undeterred, he dispersed the flames, reappearing with feet firmly planted on the corridor floor.
target: Vis invisibilis Lumian ad terram trahebat; sed non deterritus, flammas disperdidit et re apparuit, pedibus ferme in pavimento corridoris positis.

source: Clang!
target: Clang!

source: His massive form stomped heavily, causing the building to sway.
target: Eius immanis forma graviter calcitravit, aedificium vacillare faciens.

source: In a single stride, he stood before Fernandez, who had just risen.
target: Unico passu, coram Fernandez stetit, qui modo surrexit.

source: His left fist, wreathed in crimson, nearly white flames, collided with Fernandez.
target: Pugnus sinistrum, flammis rubris paene candidis circumvolutus, cum Fernandez collidit.

source: Without a moment to activate his superpowers, Fernandez raised his arms hastily to block.
target: Nullo momento facultatum suarum superarum excitandarum, Fernandez celeriter bracchia levavit ad obstruendum.

source: Boom!
target: Boom!

source: Flames erupted as Lumian’s punch sent the young man flying, crashing into the partially open side office, demolishing the wooden desk.
target: Flammae erupere coeperunt, dum pugno Lumiani iuvenem volitantem projiceret, in officium lateralem semiapertum collidens, mensam ligneam delevit.

source: Capitalizing on Fernandez’s disorientation and pain, Lumian followed, rushing into the office and delivering another punch with his left fist.
target: Ex confusione et dolore Fernandez lucratus, Lumian festinanter in officium intrans et alterum pugnum manu sinistra perferens secutus est.

source: Boom! Crimson flames, nearly white, illuminated the room as the punch explosively struck Fernandez’s chest.
target: Boom!

source: The flames were contained by an unseen force, preventing them from entirely obliterating Fernandez’s chest.
target: Flammae a vis invisibili cohibitae sunt, ne totum pectus Fernandez deleantur.

source: Instead, they crumpled, clouding the target’s vision.
target: Proinde, contritae sunt, obiecti visionem obscurantes.

source: Expressionless, Lumian halted, gazing at the semi-conscious Fernandez.
target: Sine expressione, Lumian cessavit et ad Fernandez semi–conscientem aspiciens stetit.

source: He raised his left hand.
target: Manum sinistram levavit.

source: A colossal crimson fireball, nearly white, condensed rapidly, poised to act as a Reaper.
target: Globulus magnus ignis ruber, paene candidus, celeriter condensatus est, paratus ut Messor ageret.

source: In the next instant, the fireball shot forth, homing in on Fernandez.
target: In proximo momento, globus ignis subito proiecit, ad Fernandez contendens.

source: Abruptly, it ascended, passing the target, and collided with the wall behind the desk.
target: Subito, ascendit, obiectum transiens, et muro post mensam occurrit.

source: Boom!
target: Boom!

source: Blazing white and red flames burst through the glass window, the wall, and ignited outside the Fisheries Guild building, creating fiery clouds in the air.
target: Flammae candidae et rubrae per fenestram vitream, murumque, et extra aedificium Societatis Piscatoriae eruptae sunt, nubes ignis in aere creantes.

source: Almost simultaneously, Lumian felt as though he entered a dark and profound void. Distant, resplendent stars blinked like vigilant eyes.
target: Prope simul, Lumian sensit quasi in vacuum obscurum et profundum intravisset;

source: Once more, he confronted Juan Oro, an elderly man with deeply etched wrinkles.
target: Iterum, se confrontavit cum Juan Oro, senex rugis altissime incisis.

source: At that moment, Noelia had rushed to the square where the statue of the waves stood, shouting towards the building with a fallen window frame,
target: Illo momento, Noelia ad forum cucurrit, ubi statua fluctuum stabat, et, tenens lapsam structuram fenestrarum, ad aedificium clamavit.

source: “Stop!”
target: «Siste!»

source: At the sound of the combat nun’s voice, Lumian sighed with regret, swiveled his revolver, and holstered it under his armpit. Juan Oro and the surrounding void vanished.
target: Ad sonitum vocis monialis pugnantis, Lumian maere suspiravit, revolver suum vertit et sub brachio recondidit.

source: A few minutes later, Juan Oro emerged from the grayish-black building of the Fisheries Guild with his walking stick.
target: Paucis post, Juan Oro ex aedificio cinereo–nigro Societatis Piscatoriae cum baculo ambulatorio emersit.

source: In a deep voice, he addressed Noelia, “He attacked Fernandez. You must apprehend him!”
target: Voce profunda, ad Noeliam dixit: “Fernandez oppugnavit. Illum apprehendere debes!”

source: Noelia cast a cold glance at the president of the Fisheries Guild and retorted, “Should I then invite Fernandez to the police station to assist in the investigation of the Aquina Street shooting?
target: Noelia, praesidi Societatis Piscatoriae oculis frigide intuita, respondit: “An ergo Fernandez ad stationem vigilum invitare debeam, ut in inquisitione caedis in Via Aquina assistat?”

source: “All of you, calm down and jointly maintain order in Port Santa. Otherwise, do you think the Church can’t handle any of you?”
target: “Omnes vos, quieti sitis et communiter ordinem in Portu Santa conservetis. Alioquin, putasne Ecclesiam vestram non posse quemquam ex vobis tractare?”

source: In the final words, the combat nun shifted her gaze to Lumian, issuing a warning as a gesture of fairness.
target: In verbis finalibus, monialis pugnantis oculos in Lumian convertere coepit et monitionem aequitatis gestu edidit.

source: Juan Oro fell silent for a moment before stating, “I don’t know anything about the Aquina Street shooting.”
target: Juan Oro per momentum tacuit, deinde dixit: “Nihil de caede in Via Aquina scio.”

source: With that, he turned and limped back to the Fisheries Guild with his cane, where many employees rushed to assist him.
target: Hoc facto, conversus est et claudicatione cum baculo rediit ad Societatem Piscatoriae, ubi multi operarii ad eum festinanter convenerunt.

source: Observing this, Noelia led her combat team to “escort” Lumian away.
target: Observans hoc, Noelia duxit turmam suam pugnantem ut Lumian extrinsecus comitetur.

source: Once out of the port district, the combat nun instructed her team members to slow down and create some distance, walking alongside Lumian herself.
target: Egressis e regione portuaria, monialis pugnantis turmam suam imperavit ut tardius moverentur et aliquam distantiam inter se creassent, ipsa Lumian comitans ambulans.

source: “You’re making things difficult for us. Order, understand? Superficial order must be maintained.” Noelia raised her hand, pinching both sides of her forehead. “Fortunately, you didn’t really kill Fernandez. Otherwise, I would have had no choice but to carry out the arrest.”
target: “Vos res nobis difficiles facitis. Ordo, intellegitis? Ordo superficialis conservandus est.”

source: Lumian chuckled and remarked, “If I truly wanted to kill Fernandez, he wouldn’t have survived until your intervention or Juan Oro’s rescue.”
target: Lumian subridens dixit: “Si Fernandez vere occidere voluissem, ille non superfuisset usque ad auxilium vestrum aut ad servationem Juan Oro.”

source: His words held undeniable truth.
target: Verba eius veritatem innegabilem continebant.

source: Noelia was taken aback. After a few seconds of contemplation, she spoke, “Are you displaying your attitude, strength, and confidence for the onlookers? Simultaneously, do you wish for Juan Oro to misjudge your capabilities based on this encounter?”
target: Noelia obstupuit; post paucas secundae meditationis, dixit: “An habitum, virtutem, et fiduciam tuam spectatoribus ostendis? Simul, visne ut Juan Oro facultates tuas ex hoc congressu male aestimet?”

source: Lumian remained silent. With a smile, he looked ahead and remarked, “Where did the former Governors of the Sea end up?”
target: Lumian silentium servavit. Subridente, prospiciens dixit: “Ubi finiverunt pristini gubernatores maris?”

source: Noelia fell silent for a moment before answering, “On the surface, they were dispatched to various locations. However, according to our observations, it takes at least four to five months, or no more than three years, for these Governors of the Sea to mysteriously vanish without a trace. There are often no signs of a struggle at the scene, and their families remain unharmed.”
target: Noelia paulo tacuit antequam respondit: “In superficie, variis locis dispersi sunt. Sed, secundum observationes nostras, saltem quattuor ad quinque menses aut non amplius quam tres annos requiritur ut hi gubernatores maris mysteriose sine vestigio evanescant. Saepe nulla signa certaminis in loco apparent, et familiae eorum intactae manent.”

source: Did they return to the sea voluntarily? Lumian smiled and said, “See, didn’t I gain something from dealing with Fernandez just now?”
target: Redieruntne ad mare libere?

source: The Church of Earth Mother now seemed more willing to share information.
target: Ecclesia Matris Terrae nunc videbatur magis parata esse ad informationes communicandas.

source: Noelia wasn’t upset. She smiled and added, “No one reveals all their cards from the start. Once your investigation reaches a certain point, we’ll provide more.”
target: Noelia non irata erat. Subridens addidit: “Nemo ex initio omnia sua recludit. Quoniam investigatio vestra ad certum gradum perveniet, plura dabimus.”

source: Lumian stared at the azure sea beside him, contemplating for a moment.
target: Lumian ad mare caeruleum iuxta se aspexit, paulisper meditabundus.

source: “You haven’t disclosed the intentions of your Earth Mother Church in this matter.”
target: “Non enuntiavistis quid propositum Ecclesiae Matris Terrae vestrae in hac re sit.”

source: Noelia’s eyes flickered. Suddenly, she raised her hand and pointed at the arguing pedestrians ahead, shouting, “Street brawls are prohibited!”
target: Oculi Noeliae micaverunt.

source: Before completing her sentence, she sprinted over with her team, leaving Lumian alone.
target: Antequam sententiam compleret, turma sua currens, Lumian solum reliquit.

source: Lumian scoffed and slowly shook his head.
target: Lumian irridens caput lente concussit.

source: Late at night, as Lumian was about to retire for the night, he heard the deep and hoarse voice of the Knight of Swords, as if suppressing something.
target: Nocte sero, cum Lumian ad quietem nocturnam se praepararet, vocem profundam et rauquam Equitis Gladii audivit, quasi aliquid reprimens.

source: “Clues to the whereabouts of the two targets have been found.”
target: “Indicia de locis duorum scoporum reperta sunt.”
